bio.text: Angelique Ashby is a Democratic member of the California State Senate representing District 8; she assumed office on December 5, 2022, and her current term ends on December 7, 2026.
She served on the Sacramento City Council from 2010 to 2022 and was vice mayor and president pro tempore of the council for nine of those 12 years.

She was born in Ashland, Oregon, and earned a bachelor's degree in sociology from the University of California, Davis, in 1999 and a J.D. from the University of the Pacific, McGeorge School of Law, in 2003.
Her professional experience includes serving as managing partner at Ashby Consulting Group, LLC.
